# How to add captions to a video with AI: TikTok, Hormozi and karaoke styles

**Turn a video into one with burned-in, word-timed captions: 17 animated styles or plain SRT, rendered locally with FFmpeg or HyperFrames.**

**Price:** free. Every step runs locally or only plans and writes; no API key.

**Short answer:** start with [`caption-styles`](../../caption-styles/README.md): 17 caption looks with presets: karaoke fill, active-word pop, sliding pill, word tiles, neon. The other 3 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill edit-footage-with-code --skill caption-styles --skill short-form-ffmpeg-cookbook --skill varg-video-editing
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Add Hormozi-style word-by-word captions to ./talk.mp4, 9:16, yellow active word, inside the TikTok safe zone."*

## FAQ

### How do I add word-by-word captions like Hormozi or MrBeast?

caption-styles has 17 looks (active-word pop, karaoke fill, bouncing pill, tilted word cards and more) with exact presets for font, size per format and words per screen. One word at a time is for hooks, punchlines and clips of 20 s or less; phrases read better elsewhere.

### Do I need a transcript first?

Yes, with word-level timestamps (WhisperX, ElevenLabs Scribe or a forced aligner on the script). The skill never estimates word times from text length; active words light up 1-2 frames before the voice.

### How do I burn subtitles into a video with FFmpeg?

short-form-ffmpeg-cookbook uses the subtitles filter with force_style for SRT, converts to .ass for styled or karaoke captions, and adds soft switchable subtitles with mov_text when you don't want them burned in.

### Where should captions sit on TikTok and Reels?

Keep them out of the bottom 14% and the right edge of a 9:16 frame, where the buttons sit, and at 4.5:1 contrast against what is behind them.

### Is it free?

Yes. Caption templates render locally for free and every font is OFL or Apache. Credits only apply if you also generate footage, voice or music.

### Can I translate the captions?

varg-ad-localize rebuilds captions and on-screen text in the target language for ads; see translate-and-dub-video-ads.
